notes.title: Demo Update - 6/27
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing “VanySlash”

The following update 2025/6/27

----------

2025/6/27　　Version : 1.05

・Y-axis and X-axis inversion options have been added. 
　You can access them from the in-game pause menu.

・Added tutorial explanations. Tips will appear as you progress through the game.

・Game balance has been adjusted.

----------

Thank you for your continued support of “VanySlash”.
